description: Headline Canadian indicators from Statistics Canada (StatCan): CPI/inflation, unemployment rate, GDP, and quarterly population estimates for Canada or any province/territory. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Canada inflation / CPI", "Canadian unemployment rate", "Canada GDP", "population of Canada / Ontario / Quebec / Alberta". Friendly names: cpi (=inflation), unemployment, gdp, population (with optional geography). Returns the latest value plus recent history. For anything else use statcan_series with a vector id.

geography.description: population only: canada (default), a province/territory name or 2-letter code (e.g. ontario, on, quebec, bc, yukon).

indicator.description: One of: cpi, inflation, unemployment, gdp, population.

name: statcan_indicator
title: Statcan Indicator
